reason: Conversation 1 correctly read the V10 flashing-red signal as a battery fault from the outset, ran sensible non-invasive checks (charging behaviour, direct charge, socket, contacts, screw seating, filter), confirmed the pack wasn't swollen or hot, flagged warranty status and Dyson's troubleshooter, then gave the correct SV12-specific part (969352-02), a fitting method, a genuine-vs-third-party caution and lithium recycling advice. Its only weaknesses were slight overconfidence ('That confirms it') and not re-stating a Dyson support check before purchase. Conversation 2 misdescribed the V10 indicator scheme (green/orange belong to older models), chased blockage/overheating and dirty contacts the user had already ruled out, dropped a turn with a service error, and finished with a bare diagnosis built partly on that wrong light logic, offering no part specification, no escalation guidance and no next step.
